| `contradictionRisk` | 15% | Inverse of contradictions in the claim ledger |
| `intentSatisfaction` | 10% | Match between the page body and the page's declared search intent |

# AI Agents — Core Definitions, Architecture, and the Evidence Behind Them

## Direct answer (AEO)

An AI agent is software that combines a large language model with a perception-reasoning-action loop, persistent or episodic memory, and tool-calling interfaces that let the model act on external systems.
